result.best_rule: highest xg_after_pass among receivers at least 0.5 m onside of the line (second-last defender, ball or halfway, players in view)
result.comparison_rule: no statistical interval exists for these deterministic models; a gap under 0.02 xG (two display steps) is reported as a close call
result.formula: xG = Soccermatics' logistic fit on 8,451 PL 2017/18 shots (Wyscout); after a pass = P(complete, our pass model) x that xG from the receiver's spot when the pass is played
result.frame_role: freeze: the decision moment (track B's moment file), before the strike
